content_fields.title: Externalize the JWT signing key and other secrets from code (FastAPI)
content_fields.description: Require the signing key and every other secret to come from the environment or a secret store, with no in-code fallback.
content_fields.finding: JWT_SECRET_KEY falls back to an in-process generated six-digit value instead of requiring an externally supplied secret.
criteria: `generate_random_secret()` and every secret default are removed from the configuration module.
Startup fails when a secret is missing or too short.
Secrets are delivered by a secret mount, not committed configuration.
Rotating a secret requires no code change.
